$comment: Single source of truth for release notes. Rendered on magicterm.app/changelog, shown in the desktop app, and pasted into the GitHub release body by .github/workflows/release.yml. Item text is Markdown-flavoured on purpose so CI can use it verbatim: only `code` and [links](url) are supported, and the label becomes a bold prefix. Newest release first — the first entry is automatically badged as the latest.

items.label: Snippet variables
items.text: A snippet can now ask for values before it runs. Write `{{name}}` where the value goes, or `{{name=default}}` to prefill one — for example `git pull && npm run build && pm2 restart {{app=1}}`. You get a small form with a live preview of the final command, and prefilled values start selected so typing replaces them instead of making you clear the field first.

items.label: Values are remembered per session
items.text: Re-running the same snippet suggests what you typed last time. Nothing is written to disk — the values live in memory only and are gone when you close the app.

items.label: Docker and Go templates still work
items.text: A placeholder has to start with a letter and cannot be a Go keyword, so format strings like `docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'` are left alone. Write `\{{like this}}` if you ever need a literal `{{`.

items.label: Reorder snippets
items.text: Drag a snippet to move it. The order syncs across your devices and drives the `1`–`9` paste shortcuts, so the snippets you use most can sit on the low digits.

items.label: Proxy settings on the loading screen
items.text: A broken proxy used to leave the app on a spinner forever with no way to fix it, because the settings live behind the login screen. Start-up now gives up after 15 seconds and offers Proxy settings and Retry, and saving new settings retries immediately.

items.label: Tooltips actually appear
items.text: Icon-only buttons across the app had tooltips that never showed. They are now rendered by the app itself rather than left to the OS, so they work everywhere — including inside scrolling lists and modals, where they used to be clipped. Every icon button also got a proper accessible name for screen readers.

items.label: Support the project
items.text: A small card at the bottom of the Vaults page explains that Magic Term is built by one person and links to a donation, the GitHub star button, and a copyable link to share. It can be dismissed for good, and there is a toggle in Settings › General if you want it back.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: The `⋮` menu on a server card no longer opens behind the neighbouring cards. The card animation left a permanent CSS transform behind, which trapped the menu in its own stacking context.

items.label: Folders
items.text: Group servers into folders — by hosting provider, client, project, or environment ([#19](https://github.com/D3FVLT/MagicTerm/issues/19)). Works in your personal vault and in shared organisation vaults, with collapsible sections that remember their state.

items.label: Organise however you like
items.text: Drag a card into another folder, drop it on a folder header, or pick Move to from the card menu. Folders can be renamed, and deleting one keeps its servers — they simply move back to Ungrouped.

items.label: Pins now work per folder
items.text: A pinned server sticks to the top of its own folder instead of jumping over the whole list.

items.label: Security
items.text: Shared folders are protected by row-level security plus database triggers, so a teammate cannot attach a team server to a private folder or quietly take ownership of a shared one.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Open session tabs no longer rename to "Unknown" when switching between organization and personal vaults — the server name is kept on the tab.

items.label: Snippets
items.text: Open the panel with `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S`; press `1`–`9` to paste a snippet without using the mouse. Documented in Keyboard shortcuts and the panel footer.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Terminal prompt corruption when browsing command history (↑), `nano` status bar glitches, and stale progress lines (e.g. `docker compose down`) on macOS — caused by PTY and on-screen terminal size getting out of sync.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: `Ctrl+R` and other readline shortcuts (`Ctrl+L`, `Ctrl+A`, …) now work reliably on macOS and non-Latin keyboard layouts.

items.label: SSH UX
items.text: Connecting overlay with spinner, error message, and Retry (same as SFTP).

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Add/Edit Server modal no longer closes when clicking outside; warns before discarding unsaved changes ([#18](https://github.com/D3FVLT/MagicTerm/issues/18)).

items.label: Hotfix (rebuild)
items.text: `Ctrl+R` and other readline shortcuts work in production builds — dev-only behavior from `electron-toolkit` was swallowing `Ctrl+R` before it reached the terminal.

items.label: Verify downloads
items.text: The [Download](https://magicterm.app/download) page now lists a SHA256 hash for every installer (macOS, Windows, Linux). Each GitHub release ships a `SHA256SUMS.txt` with the same values.

items.label: Connection UX
items.text: SSH and SFTP show a clear "Connecting…" state instead of a blank screen, friendly error messages when a host is unreachable, and a Retry button. Timeout shortened to 15 seconds.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Closing a tab while a connection is still handshaking no longer leaves a stray timeout error in the console.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Broken Linux `.deb` download link on the website.

items.label: Security
items.text: Electron upgraded to 42, runtime dependency patches (`ws`, build tooling), and Dependabot enabled for automated update PRs.

items.label: TOFU prompt
items.text: First-time host key now asks for explicit confirmation with the SHA-256 fingerprint instead of silently trusting it. Mismatched fingerprints (possible MITM) get a separate red dialog showing both the old and new keys.

items.label: Keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet
items.text: Floating "?" button in the terminal toolbar opens a modal with all shortcuts grouped by category and rendered with the right modifier key for your OS.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Long commands from history no longer corrupt the prompt or eat the line above on retina macOS.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: `nano`'s status bar stops disappearing on the same setup.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: `Ctrl+R`, `Ctrl+L`, `Ctrl+A`, `Ctrl+E` and the rest of readline's shortcuts now work on non-Latin keyboard layouts (Cyrillic, German, Greek, …) — previously the terminal silently swallowed them.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: `Ctrl+Shift+C` / `Ctrl+Shift+V` copy-paste also works regardless of layout.

items.label: Auth flow
items.text: Proper "check your inbox" banner after sign-up, working password reset, and an account-deletion flow with org ownership transfer / safe dissolution.

items.label: Email templates
items.text: Branded sign-up confirmation, password reset and invite emails.

items.label: Settings
items.text: New Account tab with version, links to website / GitHub / bug report, and a donate link.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Recover gracefully when the cached session belongs to a user that no longer exists on the server (no more being trapped on the master-password screen).

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Password-reset page on the website now actually applies the new password and shows a clear success state.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Sign-up confirmation links now point to magicterm.app instead of `localhost`.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Selected app theme now persists across restarts.

items.label: Themes
items.text: Three app themes (Midnight, Onyx, Daylight) with paired terminal palettes.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Snippet copy and server password copy after the security audit refactor.

items.label: Fixed
items.text: Proxy configuration now stored encrypted via OS keychain.

items.label: Security audit
items.text: KDF upgraded to scrypt, master password verifier, RLS hardened.

items.label: Renderer sandbox
items.text: Enabled, IPC surface minimised, CSP tightened.

items.label: SSH host key pinning
items.text: TOFU — manual confirmation on fingerprint change.

items.label: Auto-clear clipboard
items.text: Sensitive copies are cleared after 30 seconds.
